 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal

 Mr. D. Dutta.
 ...

Mr. Binay Panda,
 Ms. Puspita Saha.

Re. Cran 2 of 2025
 1.
Cran 2 of 2025 is an application for suspension of sentence.
The appellant was convicted under Section 498A/304B of the IPC on 21st December, 2016 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, 5th Court, Paschim Medinipur.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge, 5th Court, Paschim Medinipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The instant application for bail is canvassed on the ground that the appellant is in custody for more than 8 years.

2. Let a report be submitted by the Superintendent, Paschim Medinipur Central Correctional Home as regards the conduct of the appellant during incarceration and while he was on parole and the antecedents of the appellant.
The medical condition of the appellant shall also be indicated by the Superintendent, Paschim Medinipur Central Correctional Home in the said report.

3. Let a copy of this order be served on the counsel for the State who shall obtain necessary report and place before this Court on the adjourned date.
4.
